function.arguments:
{"script":"cat << 'EOF' > calculate_lines.sh
#!/bin/bash
keyword="keyword"
total_lines=0
find experiment -name "*.txt" -type f | while read -r file; do
    if grep -q "$keyword" "$file"; then
        lines=$(wc -l < "$file")
        total_lines=$((total_lines + lines))
        echo $total_lines > /tmp/total_lines.txt
    fi
done
if [ -f /tmp/total_lines.txt ]; then
    cat /tmp/total_lines.txt
else
    echo 0
fi
rm -f /tmp/total_lines.txt
EOF
bash calculate_lines.sh
"}
